title: Writing Methods
introduction: Methods give behaviour a name and define how values enter and leave a reusable operation.
learningOutcomes: Identify return types, parameters and arguments.
Write a method that returns a calculated value.
Use access modifiers to control where a member can be used.

activities.question: Which keyword means a method returns no value?
activities.explanation: void is the return type used when a method performs work without returning a value.

activities.question: A private method can be called freely from any unrelated class.
activities.explanation: A private member is accessible only within its containing class.
